Marcel —

Thanks for the docs and quick follow-up. Short answers below and then a couple of asks so we can issue the PO cleanly:  

1) Tax treatment: Redwood invoices EU customers from Redwood EU Holdings B.V. (NL VAT: NL123456789B01). For most B2B customers with a valid EU VAT number, we apply reverse charge (no VAT on Redwood invoice) and include both our VAT ID and the buyer VAT ID. We can also issue VAT-inclusive invoices if you prefer/redwood is registered in other jurisdictions for certain services — but default for EuroTech will be reverse-charge.

2) Fiscal representative: Redwood does not require vendors to appoint a fiscal rep for payments. If your AP requires a fiscal representative to receive net payments or for local compliance, that's between EuroTech and your chosen rep.

3) PO fields: On the PO we need: legal entity (EuroTech Shipments BV), billing address, buyer VAT number, payment currency (EUR), and a unique vendor reference or supplier ID (your internal vendor number). Our AP system will map payment to the vendor when those fields match.

Asks to close out:
- Please confirm EuroTech's VAT ID exactly as it should appear on the PO.
- Can you sign the attached Redwood PO template (Redwood_PO_template_EU.docx) and return a scanned copy?
- Any preference on invoice remit-to: Redwood EU Holdings B.V. (IBAN to follow) or our US treasury entity (delays may occur).

Cc'ing Laura (billing) and Ben (tax) to confirm the mapping on our side — Laura will create the PO, Ben will confirm the VAT line language.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Sales Manager, EMEA
Redwood Inference
